name: hoist-the-elephant
description: Interrupt local-correction drift in a long conversation, recover the governing mission or surface context gaps, and pause for confirmation before continuing.

interface.shortDescription: Re-anchor a conversation that has drifted.
interface.longDescription: An explicit-only Agent Skill for stopping a long conversation that is overfitting to recent corrections, recovering the user-owned mission and governing principles when the context supports them, surfacing material gaps or conflicts when it does not, separating stable constraints from adjustable choices, and pausing for confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Use $hoist-the-elephant to re-anchor this conversation before continuing.
Use $hoist-the-elephant to recover what should still govern this work.
Use $hoist-the-elephant because our local corrections are pulling us off course.
